`final class UniformMember`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.uniform` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UniformMember.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/uniform/UniformMember.java)

One uniform of a block, its std140 place, its current value as raw 32-bit words, and whether it changed since the backend last sent it.

## Description

A member checks each value against its [`UniformType`](/reference/pipeline/uniformtype/) and throws `IllegalArgumentException`, with its declaration in the message, when the value does not fit.
It turns dirty only when a written word differs from the stored one, so writing the same value again costs no upload.

- [Pick a uniform layout](/build/shader-translation/#pick-a-uniform-layout)

<a id="UniformMember-method-value"></a>

### value

`this value(boolean value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Writes `1` or `0` into a single `bool` or `int` member.

`this value(int... values)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Writes integers into an integer member: exactly as many as the type holds for a single value, or one or more whole elements of an array, from the first element.
A float member receives the integers as floats.

`this value(float... values)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Writes floats into a float member, with the same counts as integers.

`this value(UniformMember source)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Copies every value of another member of the same type and length, as the line variant of a shader does to follow its source shader.
